info.name: ZATCA Fatoora V2 - EasyLease (Production)
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for ZATCA Phase 2 Enterprise Integration.

### Document Types Covered:
1. **Standard B2B Invoice** (TypeCode: 388, Subtype: Standard)
2. **Simplified B2C Invoice** (TypeCode: 388, Subtype: Simplified)
3. **Credit Notes** (TypeCode: 381)
4. **Debit Notes** (TypeCode: 383)

### Authentication
All requests use HMAC-SHA256 signature generated in the `Pre-request Script`.
Required Headers: `x-client-id`, `x-timestamp`, `x-nonce`, `x-signature`.

exec: if (obj === null || typeof obj !== 'object') return JSON.stringify(obj);
const dataToSign = timestamp + nonce + method + path + bodyHash;
